note: Which automated browser journeys (release/guided-assertions.json, browser.automatedAssertions) have a tagged candidate-bound Playwright test in hosted-node.spec.ts, and why the others do not. An uncovered journey is answered not_run by the report tool, so the browser-matrix gate stays not_run for it: it can never be read as passed. Adding a test removes its entry here; scripts/check-frontend-quality.py fails when this file and the specs disagree.

uncovered.owner-and-invite: Bootstrapping an owner needs a node with no owner; the hosted-node run starts from an existing owner and member. Covered by the clean-install journey (smoke-browser-node.sh), not by Playwright.
uncovered.upstream-degradation: Stopping Jellyfin and Grimmory needs a controller on the node's host; module-outage.spec.ts mocks the API and may not stand in for a candidate run. Covered by the clean-install journey's outage stages.
uncovered.offline-reconnect: ws-reconnection.spec.ts drives a mocked socket; no candidate-bound test drops a real network yet.
uncovered.responsive-layout: mobile-layout.spec.ts needs E2E_USERNAME/E2E_PASSWORD and runs only in the default projects; it is not wired to the candidate projects yet.
